Title.description: I’m a full-stack software engineer focused on building robust, efficient, and high-character web applications. I thrive on the challenge of turning complex ideas into seamless digital experiences—spanning everything from dynamic UI design to scalable backend architecture. When I’m not writing code or structuring databases, you’ll find me analyzing role-playing games, creating content, or enjoying a great cup of coffee. Let’s build something incredible together!

Estudio Komorebi: Community management platform for Komorebi Studio.
FakeDental: A digital presence for a dental clinic, featuring a comprehensive facility gallery and a streamlined contact system.
GameNews: A gaming news platform delivering the latest industry updates, complete with dynamic search functionality for specific titles.
Sapphire Bistro: A premium web experience for a fine dining restaurant, showcasing an elegant digital menu and interactive contact form.
NutriApp: A web interface for a nutrition application, offering detailed nutritional breakdowns for a wide variety of foods.
FakeGym: A comprehensive fitness center website integrated with a custom e-commerce storefront.
